title: Slim krn-lead to pointers and audit claude -p exit handling
body:
Outcome: krn-lead SKILL.md loads only the slice loop and pointers; the Traps and Open traps sections live in .agents/skills/krn-lead/references/traps.md, read on the branch that hits them; test/rules/lead-traps.test.ts reads the new file. Today SKILL.md is 17.4 KB and loads in full every lead session (pattern: mattpocock/skills productivity/writing-for-agents, "always-loaded text costs every turn").
Also check: Claude Code 2.1.3xx makes `claude -p` exit 1 on startup failure, transcript-write loss and mid-response API error (was 0) — audit scripts/claude/* wrappers and review launchers for exit handling; decide CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT default for `-p` runs. Report: .krn/runs/lead/skills-research/report.md.
Proof: rules tests pass with the moved text; SKILL.md byte size before/after.
